prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Explore Companion Visual Styles", "Preview how your pet looks and reacts on your desktop before picking a creation path."]
1: ["Verifying Desktop Display Permissions", "Checking overlay permissions and graphics renderer to ensure your pet appears smoothly.", "Desktop overlay permission granted"]
2: ["Master Quick Desktop Controls", "Use Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly toggle pet visibility and Ctrl+Shift+M to toggle pet audio.", "Quick Command: Ctrl+Shift+P to Hide/Show Pet"]
3: ["Select Companion Movement Pace", "Customize whether your pet wanders energetically or stays calm near your desktop dock.", "Calm, Energetic, Playful"]
4: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Renderer", "Compiling companion graphics engine and desktop overlay assets..."]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick options."]
6: ["Select Your Creation Method", "Pick a quick starter pet or build a custom desktop companion from scratch."]
7: ["Secure Your Companion Account", "Sign in to save your pet's stats, customizations, and desktop memory."]
8: ["Why Connect Your Companion Account?", "Connecting an account ensures your companion is stored safely in the cloud and never resets.", "Automatic pet backup enabled"]
9: ["Your Companion Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop background to find your new pet wandering around."]
